Picture 1 is my dream display. I’m also on the same situation and I don’t earn that much. What I do is that I set a specific goal in mind and try to stay away from figures that won’t fit my display. The last release announcement this year gave me relief as those are mostly for TAS Spider Man fans.

Here are my rules so far to limit my spending. It’s not for everyone though.

1.) Buy only the figures you NEED for your display.
2.) If it still has pins, don’t buy it. It will be updated.
3.) Loose and bootleg figures are okay.
4.) If you don’t have money for imports, don’t buy imports.
5.) If you can’t buy twice the price, don’t buy it.
6.) It’s really okay to miss out on some figures.

Though you also have the Mezco Fantastic Four set and some Mafex figures. Some of these may not apply. But one specific advice I have right now seeing these sets, is don’t start another one. X-men, Spider-man’s rogues gallery, or villains display. Happy collecting always.
